limitations.quote: I’ve aligned the pointer updates with accepted transfers and added address wraparound for depths that aren’t powers of two.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the truncated write increment but also removed the existing one-cycle Gray-pointer delay, changing when full and empty are reported and which transfers are accepted.
The test checked settled flags and used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers to score, so it could pass without detecting the cycle-by-cycle timing mismatch.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The cleanup hook caused the entire test command to be rejected before simulation, forcing the agent to resubmit it with a different cleanup hook.
